Cover Test branding assets

- `youtube-light.svg` and `youtube-dark.svg`: exact standard logo paths from the YouTube page masthead at https://www.youtube.com/@TaylorSwift/videos (retrieved 2026-10-02). Wordmark paths preserve YouTube's lettering; only the text fill selects the platform's light/dark variant. Official brand resource: https://brand.youtube/youtube-logo.
- `soundcloud.webp`: unmodified transparent black horizontal logo from the official media kit, https://soundcloud.com/company/media-kit (retrieved 2026-10-02), downloaded from https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/62a0a0168756b795debc65bc/69ef2abb30d1aae32ea4f517_Horizontal%20Black%20(transparent)-download.webp.
